name: Image Variation Maker with Image Analysis Instructions
description: Img2img variation workflow that uses image analysis instructions to guide the input image using a vision model. The user supplies image_analysis_instructions to steer the caption; the caption becomes the positive prompt. denoise controls similarity (0 preserves, 1 regenerates).
use_cases: Create variations of an existing image without writing a positive prompt.

Steer the auto-captioner with image_analysis_instructions (e.g., focus on materials, color, photography style, lensing). The image_analysis_instructions can be as simple or complex as desired, e.g. 'Describe the materials, colors, and photography style of the input image. Use that caption to create a variation with the same materials and style but a different composition.'
strengths: Works from a single input image with no explicit positive prompt required.
Caption-guided variations keep semantic alignment to the input.
tradeoffs: Caption quality determines the edit direction.
High denoise values can drift from the source image.
notes: User-facing image_analysis_instructions maps to the Griptape STRING input; its output becomes the positive prompt. negative_prompt and denoise are optional overrides with defaults in the workflow.
